description: Qwen3.8 Omni Flash is a fast omni-modal reasoning model for understanding text, images, audio, and video. It is especially suited to meeting summaries, transcripts and subtitles, speaker-aware audiovisual analysis, and long-form content review. It returns text and supports a nearly one-million-token context window, tool calling, and structured output.
name: Qwen3.8 Omni Flash
